title: Technical Lead - Full Stack & Product Engineering
description:
**Company Description**
KlyONIX is a technology-driven company focused on building innovative digital products and solutions. The organization emphasizes modern engineering practices, scalability, and performance to deliver reliable software for its customers. Team members collaborate closely to design and develop full-stack applications that address real-world business challenges. KlyONIX values continuous learning, craftsmanship, and a culture of ownership, providing opportunities for professionals to grow their technical and leadership capabilities. The company fosters a supportive on-site environment in Pollachi where product thinking and engineering excellence are highly encouraged.

**Role Description**
The Technical Lead – Full Stack & Product Engineering is a full-time, on-site role based in Pollachi.
Lead engineering across ERP solutions, web/mobile applications, integrations and SaaS products. Our core business is ERP implementation with Frappe/ERPNext. We need a strong product-oriented engineer who can own architecture, delivery and technical leadership. Deep Frappe expertise is not mandatory; the ability to learn and adopt Frappe quickly is essential.

**CORE SKILLS**

**•**
Full stack: Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, production web applications, REST APIs, state management, authentication, WebSockets, performance and debugging.

**•**
Backend: Strong experience in Python, Node.js or an equivalent modern backend stack; API architecture, SQL, MariaDB/MySQL/PostgreSQL, background jobs, integrations and security fundamentals.

**•**
Mobile: Strong React Native experience; production Android/iOS apps, API integration, notifications, authentication, performance, debugging and Play Store/App Store releases.

**•**
Product Engineering: Strong product mindset; translate user/business problems into simple, scalable solutions; own features from concept to production; SaaS/product architecture; usability, scalability, technical trade-offs and technical debt.

**•**
Frappe/ERPNext: Ability to quickly learn DocTypes, ORM, Python, APIs, hooks, background jobs, custom apps, client scripting and ERPNext customization. Prior Frappe experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

**•**
Engineering: Software architecture, modular design, code quality, testing, security, Git/GitHub, code reviews, Linux, Docker, Nginx, CI/CD and practical AWS/Google Cloud knowledge.

**•**
Leadership: Technical estimation, task breakdown, architecture decisions, mentoring, PR/code reviews, development standards, production troubleshooting and ownership of technical delivery.

**PREFERRED EXPOSURE**

React • Vue • React Native • Python/Node.js • Frappe/ERPNext • MariaDB/MySQL/PostgreSQL • Docker • AWS/GCP • REST/WebSockets • AI/LLM APIs • SaaS/CRM/chat applications

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

3 to 5 years of relevant software engineering experience. Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related field preferred; strong practical engineering experience may substitute.

title: IT Technical Engineer (Full-Stack Developer)
description:
**Job Description**
 This role owns the end‑to‑end delivery of software solutions, translating solution architecture into scalable designs and hands‑on development activities. It leads to analysis, coding, configuration, testing, and integration across cloud platforms, ensuring quality, performance, and architectural alignment. The role supports Agile delivery, drives innovation through PoCs and new technologies, and ensures smooth production deployment and post‑go‑live support.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Translate solution architecture into implementable software designs, selecting appropriate technologies and platforms and ensuring alignment with architectural intent.
* Design, develop, and implement scalable cloud‑based solutions, integrating structured and unstructured data sources and enabling data automation and visualization.
* Act as a hands‑on technical expert, coding, configuring, and delivering robust software solutions using standard and AI technologies.
* Analyze requirements and ideas for technical feasibility, provide reliable technical estimates and solution proposals to support cost/benefit and program decisions.
* Ensure solution quality and architectural compliance, validating builds and releases, performing testing (automated and manual), and mitigating technical risks.
* Work within Agile / PM frameworks, actively contributing to sprints, integrations, provisioning activities, and reporting delivery progress.
* Troubleshoot complex systems and provide production support, resolving issues in existing solutions, especially during and immediately after go‑live.
* Provide technical leadership and documentation, contributing to PoCs, pilots, and prototypes, preparing technical documentation, and advising projects on technological trends and best practices.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* University degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
* 6\+ years of professional experience as a Full‑Stack Developer, with advanced proficiency across backend and frontend technologies
* Expertise on: Javascript, Angular, NodeJS, REST API, Linux OS.
* Solid experience working with AWS cloud
* Applies advanced coding practices, ensuring scalable, maintainable, and high‑quality software


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Power Platform knowledge is an advantage
* Familiarity with Azure and GCP cloud
* Good interpersonal skills


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well\-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career \& skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches \& Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development \- for your role and beyond
